name: Stroopwafels
where: Lanskroon or Rudi's at Albert Cuyp
about: These thin waffles are filled with caramel syrup. They are a classic Dutch treat sold all over Amsterdam.
tip: Check the best-before date on freshly made ones, since they do not last long.

name: Tony's Chocolonely chocolate
about: This is a Dutch chocolate brand known for its bold, uneven bars and its focus on fair cocoa sourcing.
tip: Buy the store-only flavors first, because they are hard to find elsewhere.

name: Delft Blue pottery tile
where: Heinen Delfts Blauw or the Rijksmuseum shop
about: Delft Blue is a hand-painted blue and white pottery style from the Dutch town of Delft. It is a well-known symbol of Dutch craft.
tip: Look for the official Delft mark, because many copies are sold.
